title: Pirma ni Nanay
setup: Field trip bukas, pero kailangan ng pirma ng magulang. Nasa abroad si Nanay at si Tatay ay nasa bukid pa. Sabi ni Ate Pia: 'Ako na ang pipirma. Para lang makasama ka.'
setup_en: Field trip tomorrow, but you need a parent's signature. Nanay is abroad and Tatay is still in the fields. Ate Pia says: 'I'll sign it for you. So you can come.'

choices.label: Magpapaalam ako kay Ma'am nang diretso.

success.text: Pumayag si Ma'am. Natuto kang magpakatotoo.
success.text_en: Ma'am agrees. You learn to tell it straight.

fail.text: Na-miss mo ang field trip, pero natuto ka.
fail.text_en: You miss the trip, but you learn.

callback: Utang +1 -> Singil. missed_trip -> Ch2 (Ma'am remembers honesty).
